$comment: POLICY, not commands. nen/contract.json says what this repository runs; this file says how an agent working here behaves -- which verbs gate an iteration, which tests are required, what the coverage ladder is, where a launch goes, where reports land, which commit trailers are admitted, which reviewer hanten raises for a path. nen validates this file (`nen schema check`) and reads parts of it from 0.4.0; nen/contract.json's `dependency.minimum` floors this repository at 0.20 since 2026-10-12, so it is nen-read, not merely skill-read. Keys added 2026-10-12 to match the other Kro consumers (zheref/KroApple) and Hatsu's own declaration: `reports.sections`, `profile`, `mukai.autoEn`, `direct.publish`.

reports.$comment: Reports/ is gitignored -- a session report is a working artifact, not repository content. Only the final report of an effort is kept.
reports.$sectionsComment: Which blocks each report variant renders, so `nen report render --variant` has something to render at all: with none declared the verb refuses every variant, which is what blocked aka's turn report on 2026-09-25. Modelled on zheref/hatsu's own declaration rather than invented here, so the two repositories' reports carry the same blocks in the same order. The block NAMES are configuration; every value inside a block is model-written.

profile.$comment: The run profile hatsu:ren reads (zheref/hatsu#93). `default` applies to every turn that names none; a turn may name one with --profile or the words "fast turn" / "thorough turn", and only a value in `allowed` is accepted. fast: steps 1 to 3 per turn, a turn-fast page, the launch skipped for the turn; standard: today's turn; thorough: the impacted suites (kotoamatsukami) on every turn. A landing (mukai) always runs thorough. Validated by nen schema check from v0.13.0.

models.rule: latest alias only, never a version; subagents never on the frontier tier

cursor.note: Cursor-native only; provider models there are reserved for Bugbot

mukai.$comment: Maintainer's ruling of 2026-09-28 (zheref/hatsu docs/ROSTER.md, Rulings of 2026-09-26/27/28, ruling 8): once shibari has opened the PR and the landing report is rendered, mukai OFFERS to start en on it in one line and never starts it silently -- unless this key is true, in which case en starts immediately in the same turn. Set true on 2026-10-12 on the maintainer's request that every delivered PR be driven by en to G2-readiness without a further call (the landing-page effort's brief). Read by the mukai skill only; nen validates the file and hands no value out.

direct.$comment: Opts this repository into hatsu:direct's GitHub write (the maintainer's ruling of 2026-10-05, mirrored from zheref/KroApple#619/#620): `label` applies one model/<line> label -- the primary pick's model line, never a tier, version, surface or effort -- through `nen label apply`, once per issue, after the verdict; `label+comment` also posts one marker-keyed comment per issue (`<!-- hatsu:direct -->`) carrying the primary, fallback and recommended picks. Never under ren. The five model/ labels are declared in nen/labels.json and reach GitHub through `nen labels sync` once that declaration lands on main.
